title: Centralize the decided readiness-state contract
objective: Represent the product-owner-approved readiness values as one immutable source of truth without changing behavior.
acceptance_criteria: app.py exports READINESS_STATES as the exact tuple ("ready", "degraded", "maintenance").
status() returns a value contained in READINESS_STATES.
greeting(), version(), build_info(), APP_VERSION, and the Gate 003 public contract remain unchanged.
